scenario.summary: A guest adds one simple product to the cart, opens the cart and checks that the Save for later control is not offered to guests, then removes all items and checks the empty-cart message.
steps: Add sku1 with quantity 1 from the PDP and open the cart
Check per-line-item Save for later control has count 0
Check the Remove All Items link is visible and click it
Check the empty cart message is visible and equals emptyShoppingCartMessage
stateChanges: Guest cart: product added, then all items removed
assertions: per-line-item Save for later control has count 0 (not available to a guest)
Remove All Items link is visible
Empty cart message is visible and equals 'Hi! Your shopping cart is empty.'
evidence: Title: 'verify save for later functionality is unsupported for guest user'
